install_methods.label: Install SSH Client (apt)
install_methods.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install openssh-client -y

install_methods.label: Check Windows Install
install_methods.command: powershell "if (Get-Service sshd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'OpenSSH Server is installed.' } else { Write-Host 'OpenSSH Server is not installed. Install via Settings -> Optional Features.' }"
